digest.component_or_area: completion verifier step budget and verdict caching
propositions: Verifier step budget exhausts on legitimate validation of complex tickets (epics with many child criteria), marking valid criteria as unmet when they exceed the budget floor even under authorized tool use.
Budget formula lacks evidence-surface scaling term; it does not account for child-ticket traversal costs (5-10 requests per child), causing undersizing on multi-child criteria.

Re-verification of the same ticket and criteria re-proves all assertions from scratch due to lack of cross-run result persistence, creating redundant validation cycles (~10 min/cycle) despite unchanged content.

Cached PASS verdicts seeded into a run must not be re-verified by the primary agent and must survive finalizer downgrades if their scoped content fingerprint (file blobs at the verified ref) remains valid.

Budget sizing formula must account for direct-child count and fixed overhead via new config keys (child_traversal_steps, fixed_overhead_steps), with the same formula shared by both primary sizing and recovery pool planning.
